name: Eggless Vanilla Cake
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C conventional heat. Grease and line a 20 cm round tin with baking parchment.
Sift flour, any cocoa or cinnamon, raising agents and salt together. Measure carefully; do not substitute baking soda and baking powder one-for-one.
Whisk milk with lemon juice and rest for 5 minutes, then whisk in sugar, oil and vanilla.
Add the dry mixture to the wet ingredients and fold gently until no dry flour remains. Avoid vigorous beating once flour is added.
Transfer immediately to the prepared tin and level. Bake for 30–35 minutes, checking the centre with a skewer. The skewer should come out clean and the centre should spring back lightly.
Cool in the tin for 15 minutes, then lift or turn out onto a rack. Cool fully before slicing; this makes four generous or eight smaller dessert portions.
tips: Preheat fully, use the stated tin size and begin checking at the earlier time because ovens vary.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
